question: Garhwal was the birthplace of the _______.
solution:
The correct answer is -__**Chipko Movement**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Garhwal **was the birthplace of the **Chipko Movement.**
 
• Chipko movement, also called Chipko Andolan, **nonviolent social and ecological movement by rural villagers, particularly women, in India in the 1970s, aimed at protecting trees and forests slated for government-backed logging.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****

 
• **The Jungle Bachao Andolan(1980)** took shape when the government proposed to replace the natural Sal forest of Singhbhum District, Bihar (now Jharkhand), with a commercial teak plantation.

 
• **​Narmada Bachao Andolan **is an Indian social movement spearheaded by native tribals, farmers, environmentalists, and human rights activists against a number of large dam projects across the Narmada River, which flows through the states of Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, and Maharashtra.
 
• **Bishnoi Movement** was started around 260 years back in the early part of the 18th century in Rajasthan by the Bishnoi community.
